scenarios.description: A day that falls on Monday is labeled as a Business Day.
A day that falls on Saturday is labeled as a Business Day.
A calendar contains one day whose weekday is not specified, and it is labeled as a Business Day.
scenarios.drift_explanation: The source only states that Business Day is every weekday from Monday to Friday, so a day with unspecified weekday is outside what is directly constrained. The IR makes Business Day equivalent only to Monday through Friday, so an unspecified weekday is rejected.

scenarios.description: A manager declares that a day is a Business Day before the weekday of that day is determined.
